question: The construction of Mehrangarh fort of Jodhpur was initiated during the reign of which ruler?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rao Jodha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mehrangarh Fort was constructed under the reign of **Rao Jodha**, the founder of Jodhpur in Rajasthan.
 
• Rao Jodha initiated the construction of the fort in **1459** to establish a secure stronghold and a new capital for his kingdom.
 
• The fort is situated on a rocky hill called **Bhaurcheeria**, which means the mountain of birds, rising about 400 feet above the surrounding plain.
 
• Mehrangarh Fort is renowned for its **massive walls, intricate carvings, and expansive courtyards** that showcase the architectural brilliance of the Rajput era.
 
• Over time, successive rulers of Jodhpur made additions to the fort, further enhancing its grandeur and historical importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mehrangarh Fort:** It is one of the largest forts in India and a prominent tourist attraction, known for its museum, which houses artifacts such as palanquins, weapons, paintings, and textiles.
 
• **Rao Jodha:** He was the 15th ruler of the Rathore dynasty and played a pivotal role in establishing Jodhpur as a major center in Rajasthan.
 
• **Architectural Features:** The fort includes several palaces such as Moti Mahal, Phool Mahal, and Sheesh Mahal, showcasing exquisite craftsmanship and Rajput architecture.
 
• **Historical Significance:** Mehrangarh Fort serves as a testament to the strength and resilience of the Rathore dynasty, symbolizing their defense against invasions and territorial expansion.
 
• **Location and Access:** The fort offers panoramic views of the city of Jodhpur, famously known as the "Blue City" due to its vividly painted houses around the fort area.
